name: FV_CTA_EXTRACT
description: This table stores the CTA transactions

columns.name: CTA_EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for the CTA extract file.

columns.name: CTA_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Record type for CTA transaction

columns.name: SUBMISSION_COUNT
columns.description: Submission Count, this value will increase by 1 for each subsequent submission for the period

columns.name: AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Agency location code used by federal agencies

columns.name: TAS_AGENCY_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Agency ID derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_BEG_YEAR_AVAILABILITY
columns.description: Beginning year of availability derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_END_YEAR_AVAILABILITY
columns.description: Ending year of availability derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_AVAILABILITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Availability type code derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_MAIN_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: Main account code derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_SUB_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: Sub-account code derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_ALLOC_TRANSFER_AGENCY
columns.description: Allocation transfer agency derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: TAS_SUB_LEVEL_PREFIX_CODE
columns.description: Sub-level prefix code derived from treasury account symbol

columns.name: BUSINESS_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of activity (gross disbursement, offsetting collection, investment in Treasury securities, etc.) and the effect of a transaction on the Fund Balance With Treasury. It is used in combination with the Treasury Account Symbol to classify transactions reported to Treasury through all Governmentwide Accounting  financial management systems.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_OF_REPEATED_TAS
columns.description: Indicates sequence of repeated TAS excluding BETC's.

columns.name: SUMMARIZED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Summarized amount of transactions.

columns.name: DETAIL_SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if record is a summary or detail record

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Ledger name associated with this transaction.

columns.name: RECLASSIFIED_DOCUMENT
columns.description: Unique identifier of reclassified document.

columns.name: RECLASSIFICATION_DOCUMENT
columns.description: Unique identifier of reclassification document

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL
columns.description: The identification code assigned by Treasury, in collaboration with Office of Management and Budget and the owner agency, to an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account.

columns.name: DEBIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Debit Amount for this transaction.

columns.name: CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Credit Amount for this transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of transaction (GL, AP, AR).

columns.name: REPORT_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period Name for the CTA extract.

columns.name: REPORT_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Flag indicating if report was run in proof or final mode.

columns.name: REPORTING_DATE
columns.description: Represents the Accounting Period for the transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Account segment value  for this transaction

columns.name: JOURNAL_NAME
columns.description: User entered journal header name.

columns.name: CTA_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Flag to indicate the status of the cta transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_OR_COLLECTION_CODE
columns.description: Identifies if the Business Event Type Code is payment, collection, or either.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique Id for AP Invoice Distribution transaction record

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique Id for GL Header transaction record

columns.name: AR_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique Id for AR Distribution transaction record

columns.name: VOIDED_CHECK_ID
columns.description: Check Identifier of voided payment.

columns.name: TP_RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Record type for CTA trading partner transaction (01, 02).

columns.name: TP_AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Agency location code used by trading partner.

columns.name: TP_TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL_ID
columns.description: Trading partner Identifier for treasury account symbol.

columns.name: TP_BUSINESS_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies business event type code for the trading partner.

columns.name: TP_PAYMENT_COLLECTION_CODE
columns.description: Payment or collecton code for trading partner BETC(P, C).

columns.name: VOIDED_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this is a voided transaction.
